subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: What user-visible contract should OpenClaw use when a non-mutating exec-like tool fails and the attempt has no delivered assistant reply?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the correct fix changes channel warning and terminal-turn semantics where existing code intentionally suppresses some exec-like/recoverable failures to avoid noisy or misleading replies.

options.title: Define a unified terminal-error contract
options.body: Make no-reply tool failures produce either a compact warning or incomplete-turn fallback while preserving existing suppression for delivered or explicitly acknowledged replies.

options.title: Split image placeholders from warning policy
options.body: Land only the image downgrade/replay fixes now and keep this issue open for a separate maintainer-designed exec/fallback contract.

options.title: Keep current suppression defaults
options.body: Accept that non-mutating exec-like failures without verbose details may stay silent unless a narrower, live-reproduced channel failure is filed.

recommendation.title: Define a unified terminal-error contract
recommendation.body: Make no-reply tool failures produce either a compact warning or incomplete-turn fallback while preserving existing suppression for delivered or explicitly acknowledged replies.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main and recent-terminal-classifier history match for deciding the agent runtime contract.
